description: $0.01 USDC on Solana per endpoint - the payment buys one signed memo-binding check for the one endpoint URL you name: two back-to-back fetches of its live 402 challenge, grading memo presence per leg, memo uniqueness across the pair, freshness format, header-to-body memo equality, and the correlation-field census (names only), returned as the memo-binding verdict state (BOUND, MEMO-REUSED, LEG-MISMATCH, MEMO-ABSENT, or NOT-A-402) with every factor and an as-of timestamp. Challenge side only - the seller's replay store is never implied checked.

url.description: The one endpoint URL to grade. Fetched once at check time (twice, back to back, for the memo op) and never stored.

name: payability_memo
